issue.title: Linux Swift 6.0.3 cannot type-check CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.hintTokens
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-41.2 (note #1) during the bob-cli-41 landing. Not caused by that epic: the plus-picker commits do not touch this file (git log e9b5f81^..HEAD is empty for it; blame of lines 589-631 is 14789690, 6a0263d3, 7e672cc9, aa1e73a8, and b020df7f).

Reproduced on 2026-10-03 by bob-cli-41.land on bob-mac-capture master, Swift 6.0.3 (swift-6.0.3-RELEASE, x86_64-pc-linux-gnu):

```
swiftc -typecheck Sources/CaptureCore/*.swift
```

exits 1 with:

```
Sources/CaptureCore/CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.swift:609:13: error: the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time; try breaking up the expression into distinct sub-expressions
Sources/CaptureCore/CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.swift:625:16: error: the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time; try breaking up the expression into distinct sub-expressions
```

Both sites are inside `hintTokens(numberedRows:)`, one long `[HintToken]` concatenation (`tokens += ...` when `numberedRows >= 2`, and the shorter `return tokens + ...` path). The compiler's own hint is the fix: bind the pieces to named locals before combining them.

macOS 26 CI Build succeeds for the same tree (runs 37157187639 and 37158683771), so this is the Linux 6.0.3 type checker, not a macOS compile error. It is not bob-cli-1u (closed Linux process-termination tests), bob-cli-3m (`CapturePreviewState.pending` in CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2024), or bob-cli-3x (two close-test assertion failures that appear only after the Mac suite compiles).

Impact: `swift test` of CaptureCore does not compile on this Linux host, so agents here cannot run the CaptureCore suite, including the plus-picker presentation tests.

task_type_fields.impact: Linux agents cannot compile or run the CaptureCore test suite, including plus-picker presentation tests. macOS CI still builds the file; its Test step is blocked separately by bob-cli-3m.
task_type_fields.repro: On Linux Swift 6.0.3, in bob-mac-capture: `swiftc -typecheck Sources/CaptureCore/*.swift` (and `swift test`) fails at CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.swift:609 and :625 with "the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time". Reproduced 2026-10-03 on master by bob-cli-41.land. The file is unchanged by the plus-picker commits. macOS 26 CI Build of 098e67e succeeds.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-41.2 proposed this while landing the plus picker. Linux Swift 6.0.3 cannot type-check CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.hintTokens, which blocks swift test of CaptureCore and is not caused by the picker.
